# S4.14b — subagent/hosted security enrichments + label branches

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.14a` (PR #77) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the Stage-4 security enrichments across containment,
subagent/hosted composition, credentials, bundle attestation, and
identity rotation. Containment gains the `user_space_kernel`,
`microvm`, `external`, and `transparent_redirect` backend classes
behind a single `for_policy(policy)` selection (no more hard-coded
reference model at the embed sites), with substrate-attestation
gating — stronger classes emit `Attested` enforcement evidence only
when an attestation resolves, and refuse without one
(`R-2.8.4¹`, AC-R-2.8.4-{12,13}). `set_phase` re-derives effective
containment through deny-wins `meet::effective()` over sealed
per-phase `policy_rule` layers, with typed refusals for undeclared
phases, non-`policy_rule` bases, and unentitled loosening.
Subagents gain `ContextIsolation::LabelBranch` with `spawn_branch`
(`spawned` carries `isolation`/`ctx0`/`clearance`) and
`return_from_branch` exits — `abandon`, `labeled_return`
(`external` + union taint; a claimed label dropping required taint
is `BranchTaintEscaped`), `attested_return` (capacity-bounded
schema endorsement; free text is `BasisNotAllowed`; child-side
endorsement is `IllegitimateEndorsement`) — plus `branch`-remedy
consumption and the `ClearanceExceeded`/`BranchContextMissing`
refusals (R-2.8.2 Stage-4 slice, AC-R-2.8.2-6). Hosted children
compose through the `HostedPlane` trait seam — the kernel never
decomposes an `OpaqueProcess` — producing `participant_class =
hosted` manifests with capability-declaration refs; hosted calls
outside the declared capability vector refuse at the boundary, and
unresolvable/unpinned hosted refs are definition errors
(`R-2.8.1¹`, AC-R-2.8.1-4). Hosted `credential_supply` is enforced:
only declared channels bind, a participant without them gets none,
and a subagent's credential ask outside the parent's grant is
`ScopeExceedsChannel` (LT-07, `R-2.8.3¹`, AC-R-2.8.3-7). Bundles
carry `traces.audit_tree_head` — the signed-checkpoint claim only
when a signed checkpoint exists, never a fabricated attestation
(`R-2.8.6¹`, AC-R-2.8.6-{8,10}). Identity rotation lands
end-to-end: `idp/2` (SHA-512), profile-aware
digest/parse/verify, `RotationPlan`/`BridgeRecord`/`IdMigration`,
the `rotation`-kind checkpoint with verified rehash +
bridge/attestation refs, hosted events-only `n/a{observability}`
audit views, and the lab-wide audit index surfacing `Equivocation`
on conflicting auditor-held heads (`R-2.8.6¹`, `R-2.1.5¹`,
AC-R-2.1.5-6).

Requirement ids: `R-2.8.4¹`, `R-2.8.1¹`, `R-2.8.3¹`, `R-2.8.6¹`,
`R-2.1.5¹`, `R-2.8.2` (Stage-4 slice).
Gates: `AC-R-2.8.1-4`, `AC-R-2.8.2-6`, `AC-R-2.8.3-7`,
`AC-R-2.8.4-{12,13}`, `AC-R-2.8.6-{8,10}`, `AC-R-2.1.5-6`,
`removability(0…3)` — all deterministic.

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-wire`** — `sha512.rs` (new): NIST-known-answer
  SHA-512 for the `idp/2` profile.
- **`crates/hh-identity`** — `IDP_2` (SHA-512); profile-aware
  `idp_digest`/`parse_id`/`verify_id`; `rotation.rs` (new):
  `RotationPlan` (registered+distinct profiles, `from_profile`
  binding), `BridgeRecord` (sealed, resolves, `Unbridged` typed),
  `IdMigration`/`migrate_id` (`IdpNotWritable` on retired target).
- **`crates/hh-ledger`** — `rotation.rs` (new): the `rotation`-kind
  checkpoint carrying verified rehash + `bridge_record_ref` +
  `attestation_ref` + prev-chain; `rotation` through the plain
  `checkpoint` op refuses. Profile-parameterized
  event/tree/checkpoint hashing; `security.audit.bridge` class;
  `verify_run` re-verifies the rehash; `audit_view` under
  events-only observability renders ledger-internal components
  `n/a{observability}`; lab-wide `audit_index` records auditor-held
  heads and surfaces `Equivocation` on conflicting claims.
- **`crates/hh-containment`** — `BackendClass::{UserSpaceKernel,
  Microvm, External, TransparentRedirect, Namespaces}`;
  `for_policy(policy)` is the single selection; `NetPlane` splits
  `BridgedChannel` from `TransparentRedirect`; the `Attestation`
  gate — attesting classes refuse without a resolving substrate
  attestation and mint `Attested` evidence only under one;
  `external` reports `reported` never `probed`; plane-aware probes.
- **`crates/hh-env`** — `set_phase` applies sealed `policy_rule`
  layers through `meet::effective()`; typed refusals for
  undeclared phase, wrong basis, and `ContainmentWidening`.
- **`crates/hh-embed`** — the three `open.rs` provisioning sites
  call `for_policy` instead of `Ep2Model::reference()`;
  `environment_spec` surfaces optional substrate attestation.
- **`crates/hh-subagent`** — `branch.rs` (new): `BranchExit`
  closed set + `spawn_branch`/`return_from_branch` + typed
  refusals; `hosted.rs` (new): the `HostedPlane` trait seam —
  `spawn` composes hosted children through it
  (`participant_class = hosted`, hosting mechanism, capability
  declaration); `types.rs`: `ContextIsolation::LabelBranch`,
  `SpawnCtx.{branch_ctx, hosted_plane}`, `SubagentSpec.context`;
  spawned events carry `isolation`/`ctx0`/`clearance`.
- **`crates/hh-orchestrator`** — `SpawnCtx` construction updated
  for the new seam members.
- **`crates/hh-bundle`** — `traces.audit_tree_head` written only
  when a signed checkpoint exists; the attestation predicate
  resolves checkpoint refs.
- **Tests** — `hh-subagent` s4_14b (14), `hh-containment` s4_14b
  (6), `hh-env` s4_14b (5), `hh-ledger` s4_14b_rotation (5),
  `hh-bundle` s4_14b (2), `hh-hosting` s4_14b (2), `hh-secrets`
  s4_14b (1).
